$comment: The first chunk of a reply sent to the synthesiser (T-0605, AUDIT V7).
CosyVoice cannot start a line before it has made its first hop of speech, so the shorter the first chunk, the sooner the first word.
Rule: within the first sentence, cut after the first comma, semicolon or dash that follows at least `minWords` words,
provided the clause is at most `maxWords` words. The punctuation must be followed by whitespace (a decimal 3,5 is not a cut).
A sentence end (. ! ? or a newline) before such a mark means no cut: the sentence is already the first chunk.
`rest` is empty-or-absent when there is no cut. The rest of the reply follows sentence by sentence as before.
Read by aura-adapter/tests/test_clause.py (the adapter, which phone and car speak through) and jarvis-web/src/lib/hermes/speech.test.ts.
